title: The young inventor won an award for his creative ______ to water pollution.
analysis: a creative solution to ... 表示“针对……的创造性解决方案”，solution 与介词 to 搭配。
source: 2027年中考英语人教版模拟卷·单项选择26（21世纪教育网 26942222）

title: Learning calligraphy takes time and patience, but it helps me calm down and ______ stress.
analysis: reduce stress 表示“减轻压力”，与前文 calm down 语义一致。
source: 2027年中考英语人教版模拟卷·单项选择27（21世纪教育网 26942222）

title: Tea from China began to be sent ______ more than a thousand years ago and since then it has been known to the world.
analysis: be sent abroad 表示“被送往国外”，abroad 是副词，符合语境。
source: 2027年中考英语人教版模拟卷·单项选择28（21世纪教育网 26942222）

title: —My brother keeps exercising for one hour every day. —I believe that his ______ will bring him good results.
analysis: 坚持锻炼是一种 effort（努力），努力会带来好结果。
source: 2027年中考英语人教版模拟卷·单项选择29（21世纪教育网 26942222）

title: —AI tools can help us find information much faster. —Yes, but we must use them ______. They should not do all the thinking for us.
analysis: use them wisely 表示“明智地使用它们”，与后文提醒相呼应。
source: 2027年中考英语人教版模拟卷·单项选择30（21世纪教育网 26942222）

title: —A balanced diet and everyday exercise are the keys to good health. —You're right. We cannot achieve our goals ______ we have a strong body.
analysis: unless 表示“除非”，相当于 if ... not，符合“除非身体强壮，否则无法实现目标”的语义。
source: 2027年中考英语人教版模拟卷·单项选择31（21世纪教育网 26942222）

title: —Congratulations on your success, Paul! I'm so ______ you. —Thanks a lot. I couldn't have done it without your support.
analysis: be proud of sb 表示“为某人感到骄傲”，符合祝贺语境。
source: 2027年中考英语人教版模拟卷·单项选择32（21世纪教育网 26942222）

title: —Mr Green, Leo is waiting for you in the meeting room. —I hope he hasn't waited for too long. Do you know when he ______?
analysis: 由“已经在会议室等”可知动作已发生，宾语从句用一般过去时 arrived。
source: 2027年中考英语人教版模拟卷·单项选择33（21世纪教育网 26942222）

title: —Have you ever heard of Xu Yuanchong, a great translator? —Yes. His translated works keep the beauty of the ______ Chinese poems.
analysis: original Chinese poems 表示“中国古诗原作”，与 translated works 相对。
source: 2027年中考英语人教版模拟卷·单项选择34（21世纪教育网 26942222）

title: —I'm sorry I forgot to bring the book I promised you. —______. You can bring it next time.
analysis: 对方道歉时应回答 It doesn't matter（没关系）。
source: 2027年中考英语人教版模拟卷·单项选择35（21世纪教育网 26942222）
